opportunities.title: Montgomery County SHRM — Chapter meetings & holiday programs
opportunities.whyPursueNow: MCSHRM has demonstrated repeat, paid, in-person programming in hotel and banquet-style venues, including a recurring holiday format and full-day leadership programming. The immediate 2026 holiday event is already committed to Manor Country Club, so the actionable reason to pursue now is to get Bethesda Marriott considered for the 2027 calendar, a future leadership conference, breakfast/dinner meeting, or overflow/alternative sourcing—not to imply an open RFP or booking.
opportunities.salesOutreachRecommendation: Have Bethesda Marriott sales approach Neha Agarwal first, with Suzanne M. Motta copied or introduced, using a concise local-catering proposal rather than a guestrooms pitch. Ask who owns 2027 venue decisions, when the annual meeting calendar is set, whether Manor is contracted for 2027, and what attendance, budget, meal format, AV, parking, and accessibility requirements apply. Offer two concrete options: a small breakfast/education meeting in a Pooks Hill-sized room and a larger dinner/holiday or leadership program with private dining/ballroom flexibility. Do not position December 2, 2026 as open business.
opportunities.bethesdaFit: Bethesda Marriott is a credible local-catering alternative for a future MCSHRM meeting, breakfast, leadership program, or holiday event: the hotel advertises 27 event rooms, 18,719 square feet of event space, a largest-space capacity of 450, private dining at Cooper's Mill, custom menus, and small rooms including Pooks Hill with 30-person banquet capacity. Its Bethesda/Pooks Hill location fits the Bethesda–Rockville corridor, but the account's demonstrated incumbent is Manor Country Club and MCSHRM has also used DoubleTree Gaithersburg, Pinstripes North Bethesda, and Smokey Glen Farm.

opportunities.title: PMI Montgomery County — Monthly dinner meetings & FedTALKS
opportunities.whyPursueNow: The chapter is actively publishing recurring dinner programming and has an upcoming November 17 FedTALKS touchpoint, while the current monthly-dinner venue is consistently a restaurant in the same Bethesda–Rockville corridor. This is a timely local catering prospect, not a confirmed hotel booking.
opportunities.salesOutreachRecommendation: Email Matt Lowy at president@pmimontcomdchapter.org with a short local-venue alternative: Bethesda Marriott can host a 6:30–9:00 p.m. chapter dinner in a smaller meeting room or private-dining setup with buffet/dinner service, presentation support, and Zoom simulcast; ask who owns venue contracting (Matt, the VP Programs function, or another planner), whether That’s Amore is contracted for 2027, typical attendance/food-and-beverage minimum, AV requirements, and whether one pilot dinner or the annual member-appreciation dinner is open to bids. Do not pitch a room block unless they identify an overnight need. Follow up once after five business days; if there is no response, route a light-touch account-development note through the chapter’s public contact channel.
opportunities.bethesdaFit: Strong catering/day-meeting fit: Bethesda Marriott’s official event page lists 27 event rooms, 18,719 square feet of event space, a 450-person largest-space capacity, smaller rooms including Pooks Hill and Bethesda with banquet capacity, private dining at Cooper’s Mill, and in-house dinner catering. The hotel is at 5151 Pooks Hill Road in Bethesda. This supports a direct alternative proposal for a recurring dinner with presentation/AV and Zoom capability, but it does not establish that PMI-MC needs a hotel venue or that the hotel can displace That’s Amore. Guestrooms should be positioned as optional, not assumed.

customerFacingBody.title: PMI Montgomery County — Monthly dinner meetings & FedTALKS
customerFacingBody.whatIsHappening: Recurring PMI-MC in-person/hybrid monthly dinner meetings are evidenced at That’s Amore Restaurant in Rockville: May 6, September 2, October 7, and November 4, 2026, plus September 3 and October 1, 2025. Published formats include social hour/check-in, dinner or buffet, chapter remarks, a 1.75-PDU presentation, and Zoom simulcast. FedTALKS 2026 is a separate industry event on November 17, 2026, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., at the Waldorf Astoria in Washington, D.C.; the chapter page describes it as hosted by FedScoop and does not indicate that PMI-MC is the venue buyer.
